{{Quote|We've picked up something.|The communications officer|<ref name="The Story of the Faithful Wookiee" />}}
A being of a [[Color/Legends|reddish-purple]] [[Species/Legends|species]] with black [[eye]]s worked as a '''communications operator''' for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] at an [[Ring Base|base]] in an [[Unidentified asteroid field (Rebel Alliance base)|asteroid field]].<ref name="The Story of the Faithful Wookiee" /> At some point between [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref><ref name="Leland Holiday">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=870#15778940|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2006-10-12|time=6:13 PM}}</ref> the communications operator picked up a signal from a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] while working at the base, and informed [[General/Legends|General]]<ref name="The Story of the Faithful Wookiee" /> [[Ristt]],<ref name="Bad Feeling">{{InsiderCite|106|I Have a Bad Feeling About This!}}</ref> [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], and their  [[droid/Legends|droids]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] of their detection. Skywalker quickly identified the ship as the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]'', before the communications officer then explained that the ''Falcon'' was coming out of [[Lightspeed/Legends|Lightspeed]] and could not make contact with the ship. In an attempt to make contact with the ''Millennium Falcon'', General Ristt ordered the operator to move to a lower communications channel, which the operator promptly did, allowing the operator to display a live recording from inside the [[Cockpit/Legends|Cockpit]] of the ''Millennium Falcon'' on the [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] they were using.<ref name="The Story of the Faithful Wookiee" />

The operator then attempted to hail the ''Millennium Falcon'', but received no response from the oncoming ship. As the operator failed to make contact, the rebels stood behind them quickly identified and located [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in the cockpit of the ''Falcon'' via the viewscreen. The communications operator then announced their failure to make contact, to the rebels standing behind, before once again attempting to make contact with the [[freighter/Legends|freighter]]. As they did so, Ristt realized the ''Falcon'' was on a collision course with the rebel base, causing the rebels stood behind the communications operator to briefly discuss Chewbacca's reasoning before Leia then ordered the operator to hold their fire. However, the communications operator then lost all contact with the freighter as it neared the rebel base. In the end however, the ''Falcon'' narrowly dodged the rebel base, leaving the it unharmed.<ref name="The Story of the Faithful Wookiee" />

A [[Unidentified Rebel cartoon|cartoon]] was later produced by the Rebel Alliance that depicted the events at the Rebel Base involving the communications operator and the subsequent [[Mission to Panna Prime]], which was watched by Chewbacca's son [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawarrump]]<ref name="Holiday Special">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref> in 1 ABY.<ref name="holidayspecialtimeline">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=870#15778940|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2006-10-12|time=6:13 PM|quote=Wookiee Life Day occurs every 3 years, one of which fell at ~1.5 ABY.}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The communications operator appeared in ''[[The Story of the Faithful Wookiee]]'',<ref name="The Story of the Faithful Wookiee" /> a cartoon that aired on television as part of the ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'',<ref name="Holiday Special" /> which aired on [[November 17]], [[1978]].<ref name="Boba Fett: Mystery Man">{{GalaxyCite|1|Boba Fett: Mystery Man in Not-So-Shining Armor}}</ref> The cartoon was later included as an [[Easter egg (virtual)|Easter egg]] on the [[2011]] [[Wikipedia:Blu-ray Disc|Blu-ray]] release of ''[[Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]''.<ref name="blu-ray">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]''</ref>
